faq.question: When should I choose air freight over sea cargo?
faq.answer: Air freight is recommended when shipment speed is critical or when handling smaller, higher-value goods where ocean freight timelines are unsuitable.

faq.question: Are there weight limits for air freight shipments?
faq.answer: Air freight can accommodate shipments from single packages up to heavy palletized freight, subject to aircraft hold cargo dimensions.

seo.metaTitle: Air Cargo Shipping Services Pakistan | Raahi International
seo.metaDescription: Air cargo shipping with door-to-door delivery originating from Pakistan export hubs to international destinations.

children.text: Air freight represents the fastest method for moving international shipments. Connecting major commercial export airports in Pakistan (such as Lahore, Karachi, and Islamabad) with worldwide air terminals, air cargo services support critical supply chain deadlines.

Proper packaging is vital for air transit safety. Shipments should be enclosed in durable double-walled corrugated boxes or reinforced crates, with clear address labeling and airway bill documentation.

keyConsiderations: Ocean freight involves longer transit schedules compared to air cargo

Port handling and terminal charges apply at origin and destination

processSteps.title: Cargo Consolidation & Port Booking
processSteps.description: Cargo is consolidated and scheduled for ocean vessel departure from port terminals.

processSteps.title: Port Clearance & Loading
processSteps.description: Export documentation and customs clearance are completed prior to vessel loading.

processSteps.title: Ocean Voyage
processSteps.description: Shipment travels via maritime shipping routes to the destination sea port.

processSteps.title: Destination Port Discharge
processSteps.description: Cargo is discharged at the destination port for import processing and collection.

faq.question: What is the primary advantage of sea cargo?
faq.answer: Sea cargo offers significantly lower freight costs per cubic meter for large, heavy, or bulky international shipments.

faq.question: How long does ocean freight take from Pakistan?
faq.answer: Transit times vary depending on the destination port and maritime shipping routes.

seo.metaTitle: Sea Cargo Shipping Services Pakistan | Raahi International
seo.metaDescription: Sea cargo shipping with door-to-door delivery from Pakistan for ocean freight requirements.

children.text: Ocean shipping is the cornerstone of global trade, carrying bulk merchandise and commercial products across international waters. Operating through port access in Pakistan, sea cargo services facilitate bulk commodity and commercial export trade.

Cargo is loaded into marine containers designed to withstand maritime weather conditions. Heavy items must be adequately blocked, braced, and weight-distributed within crates or pallets to prevent movement during voyage transit.

faq.question: What documents are required for commercial export cargo from Pakistan?
faq.answer: Commercial shipments typically require a Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Certificate of Origin, and relevant export regulatory permits.

faq.question: Can commercial cargo be shipped via both air and sea?
faq.answer: Yes, commercial goods can be transported via air freight for urgent supply chains or sea cargo for larger ocean trade volumes.

Commercial freight should be secured on standard heat-treated pallets or enclosed wooden crates to enable safe forklift loading and airport/port terminal handling.

faq.question: Why ship excess baggage as cargo instead of carrying it on the airline?
faq.answer: Shipping excess luggage via international cargo is significantly more economical than paying airline counter rates for extra suitcases.

faq.question: What items cannot be packed in personal excess baggage?
faq.answer: Flammables, hazardous chemicals, food items, aerosols, and lithium batteries are prohibited in personal baggage shipments.

children.text: Relocating or studying abroad often involves transporting more personal belongings than standard airline tickets allow. Excess baggage cargo services offer an affordable, reliable option for shipping extra suitcases, clothing, books, and household goods internationally.
